documented_expectation: TESTING.md documents `python verify.py --root` as printing exactly this value (SPE_VERSION 1.2.2 generation), byte-for-byte, for cross-machine comparison.
hash_recipe: sha256(json.dumps({event_type, payload, prev_hash, timestamp, nonce}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
root_definition: sealed_hash of the last event; an empty chain yields the sentinel ROOT
